On a productive turn, rules for the gate team
This section explains the steps for the whole desk
Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section explains how the Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews animal travel requests, checks readiness, and supports safe boarding. Staff must greet travelers in a calm, neutral tone and keep the conversation focused on required documents, crate condition, and animal welfare. When a bird is presented for travel, the agent must confirm <<FACT F065>> and then review the rest of the case without delay or debate.

The desk accepts only animals that appear fit for travel and are handled in a humane manner at all stages. Staff should look for secure containment, clean ventilation, and enough space for the animal to stand, turn, and settle naturally. If a bird is involved, the agent must also verify <<FACT F077>> and then continue with the normal acceptance review. If anything is unclear, the matter should be paused and sent to the senior coordinator for review before acceptance is completed. Never rush a traveler, and never make promises that the documents do not support.

When a pet is accepted, the desk should give clear guidance on check-in, transfer, and gate presentation. Handle each case with steady wording, careful recordkeeping, and respect for the passenger and the animal. If a traveler arrives with Chester or another companion animal, the same standards apply, and the staff member must follow the approved screening steps in sequence.

If guidance is needed, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for immediate support.
